_note: How life in Dubai Life works. Shown as cards in onboarding (the 'Your Dubai' step) and in full on /guide. Keep in step with the design spec and the game's rules.
intro: You've just landed at DXB with AED 50,000 and a 30-day visit visa. Here's how to build a life here.

sections.title: Beat the visa clock
sections.summary: You arrive on a 30-day visit visa. Move up the ladder before it runs out.
points: 🛬 Visit visa (30 days): where everyone starts. The clock only runs on days you play; overstaying costs AED 50 a day.
🎓 Student visa (90 days): graduate from a course in Academic City.
💼 Employment visa (2 years): get a job on the Job Board or at a shop or venture.
🧑‍💻 Freelance visa (5 years): earn AED 360,000 and hold a degree.
🌟 Golden Visa (10 years): own AED 2,000,000 of property bought with money you earned, or graduate with honours and run a venture with staff.

sections.title: Make your money last
sections.summary: Living costs come out at 09:00 GST on days you play. Watch your runway.
points: Your Blueprint sets where you live, how you get around, your phone plan, gym and money sent home.
Runway = your wallet ÷ your daily costs. Under 14 days, the Expat Trap warning appears.
Keep 90+ days of runway and you earn the Financial Discipline Yield every week.
Away for a while? You're charged for at most 3 days, and your visa clock waits for you.

sections.title: Earn a living
sections.summary: Get hired today, then build your own business with friends.
points: City companies on the Job Board hire on the spot. Better jobs need a course, a degree or a driving license.
Work one shift a day; wages are paid every Friday at 17:00 GST.
Start a venture (from a karak café to a yacht charter), invite friends as partners, post jobs and hire other players.
Qualified staff make a venture earn up to 3× more.

sections.title: Learn and level up
sections.summary: Study in Academic City and pass the driving test to unlock better jobs and visas.
points: Brain University, Crescent and Falcon universities, and the Foundation Academy: one new lesson a day per course.
Graduating unlocks the student visa and raises your pay; books are summarised chapter by chapter.
The Driving Academy: eye test, theory and Smart Yard parking. A license unlocks cars and driving jobs.
Certificates are in-game achievements, not accredited qualifications.

sections.title: Spot the scams
sections.summary: Scam calls and texts will try to trick you. Report them for a bounty.
points: A few times a week, a fake call or text arrives on your in-game phone (always marked SIMULATION).
Report it to e-Crime for an AED 500–1,000 bounty. Fall for it and you lose up to 10% of your wallet (never more than AED 5,000).
Every scam ends with the red flags and what the real version looks like.

sections.title: Make friends
sections.summary: Meet players in venues, share a flat, team up and earn together.
points: Tap anyone in a venue to chat, wave, dance, buy them a drink or send money.
Choose a shared bed space and you're matched with roommates.
Friend quests: you and a friend both score 100 points in a week and you each get AED 2,000.
Invite friends: you both get AED 10,000 once they've played 3 days.

sections.title: Compete and win
sections.summary: Everything you do scores points for the weekly league and the monthly tournament.
points: Points come from lessons, scam reports, shifts, multiplayer wins and healthy days, never from buying.
Weekly leagues of 30 players: the top 7 move up to the next tier.
The monthly tournament winner gets {prize}. Free to enter, 21+, skill only.
The season pass and Dubai Plus add titles, frames and badges for your profile.

sections.title: Stay well
sections.summary: Eat, rest, have fun and see friends. Feeling great pays.
points: Your needs (hunger, energy, fun, social, hygiene) show in the dock at the top.
Above 85% you're a Peak Performer: better pay and faster learning.
Below 30% you burn out and lose your bonuses until you recover.
